How it’s drawn

510 km of road and 790 named streets from Overture Maps release 2026-08-19.0, clipped to the Census Bureau’s boundary for ZIP 15068. State routes are orange, the dashed line is the ZIP boundary, and the river and creeks come from the same open data. Every line is rounded to the nearest metre, and the coordinates under the title are the centre of New Kensington.
